# PhysioFix

> PhysioFix is a physiotherapy clinic in JP Nagar, Bangalore, led by Dr.Nishmitha.R (MPT), offering sports rehab, neuro rehabilitation, post-surgery recovery, chiropractic care, posture correction and home physiotherapy across Bangalore.

PhysioFix helps people recover from pain and injury with evidence-based physiotherapy. The clinic treats back pain, neck pain, knee pain, frozen shoulder, sciatica, plantar fasciitis, sports injuries and post-surgical rehabilitation for patients in JP Nagar and greater Bangalore.

## Site

- [Home](https://physiofix.net/): PhysioFix clinic overview, services and booking
- [About](https://physiofix.net/about): About Dr.Nishmitha.R and the clinic
- [Services](https://physiofix.net/services): Full list of treatments offered
- [Contact](https://physiofix.net/contact): Clinic address, phone and booking form
- [Blog](https://physiofix.net/blog): Physiotherapy, injury recovery and wellness articles

## Specializations

- [Chiropractic Care](https://physiofix.net/specialization/chiropracticCare): Spinal and joint alignment
- [Manual Therapy](https://physiofix.net/specialization/manualTherapy): Hands-on joint and soft-tissue treatment
- [Cupping Therapy](https://physiofix.net/specialization/cuppingTherapy): Myofascial decompression therapy
- [Electrotherapy](https://physiofix.net/specialization/electrotherapy): TENS, IFT and ultrasound therapy
- [Physiotherapy Assessment](https://physiofix.net/specialization/physiotherapyAssessment): Comprehensive movement evaluation
- [Bone Alignment](https://physiofix.net/specialization/boneAlignment): Structural alignment therapy
- [Soft Tissue Manipulation](https://physiofix.net/specialization/softTissueManipulation): Muscle and fascia release
- [Neuro Rehabilitation](https://physiofix.net/specialization/neuroRehabilitation): Stroke and neurological recovery
- [Posture Correction](https://physiofix.net/specialization/postureCorrection): Ergonomic and postural retraining
- [Post-Surgery Rehabilitation](https://physiofix.net/specialization/postSurgeryRehabilitation): Structured surgical recovery programs
- [Home Physiotherapy](https://physiofix.net/specialization/homePhysio): At-home treatment visits in Bangalore
- [Geriatric Physiotherapy](https://physiofix.net/specialization/geriatricPhysio): Care for older adults
- [Sports Physiotherapy](https://physiofix.net/specialization/sportsPhysio): Injury prevention and return-to-sport
